reviews.text: I bought Groovy (warm orange-y brown + pink, coral and gold glitter) and Rub-a-dub (neutral brown + blue, aqua and silver glitter), and both are super pretty. The pans are much bigger than I thought they'd be, so they'll last a long time. The glitters aren't chunky and uncomfortable, though they are on the larger side. I haven't had any problems with getting them in my eyes, but there is a bit of fallout.
reviews.zh: 我買咗 Groovy（暖橙啡色＋粉紅、珊瑚色同金色閃粉）同 Rub-a-dub（中性啡色＋藍色、水藍色同銀色閃粉），兩款都好靚。眼影格比我想像中大得多，所以可以用好耐。閃粉唔會粗到好唔舒服，雖然粒度比較大。我未試過閃粉跌入眼內，不過會有少少掉粉。

reviews.text: i bought the 3rd shade and the glitters are GORGEOUS! they look more like an ivory shade in the container, but if you apply it on your skin it really has an opalescent effect. the brown shade is very pretty as well, i expected it to be more of a taupe-ish shade but it’s more like a soft brown. the color of the matte shade may change based on what you wear underneath the makeup ( for example sunscreen)
reviews.zh: 我買咗第三個色，閃粉好靚！喺盒入面睇落似象牙白，但係搽喺皮膚上就真係有蛋白石般嘅光彩效果。啡色都好靚，我以為會係灰啡色，但係更似柔和嘅啡色。霧面眼影嘅顏色可能會因為你底下搽咗乜嘢而有所變化（例如防曬）。

reviews.text:
the sparkles are gorgeous opal color and easy to apply. with just a little tap you can collect a good amount of glitter. the gltiiers are chunky with finer glitters mixed into it and they give such a pretty effect when it hits the light. the matte shade is super cute as well. its light and easy to layer which I love. i expected it to be more of a taupe countour-like shade but it's more of a soft nude brown. the color can get a little darker when applied on top of products like sunscreen but that's fine for me since I don't wear much base makeup

9/10 definitely recommended
reviews.zh:
閃粉係好靚嘅蛋白石色，容易上妝。只需要輕輕拍一下，就可以拿到好多閃粉。閃粉係粗閃粉夾埋細閃粉，照到光時效果好靚。霧面色都好得意。佢好薄、容易疊色，我好鍾意。我本來以為會係類似修容嘅灰啡色，但係更似柔和嘅裸啡色。喺防曬之類嘅產品上面搽，顏色會深啲，不過我唔介意，因為我唔太搽底妝。

9/10，絕對推薦。

reviews.text: It is exactly what I expected. Very easy to apply and very pretty. My photo is after 12 hours. The photo is not really showing the eyeshadow's true beauty. I want to assure you that it is so stunning. You won't be wrong getting this. It is a good eyeshadow when you only have 5-10mins to get all the make-up ready to go. I hope they release more colours.
reviews.zh: 完全符合我嘅期望。好易上妝，又好靚。我張相係 12 個鐘之後拍嘅。張相其實唔係好能夠展現到眼影嘅真正美態。我想保證，佢真係好靚。買呢款你唔會後悔。如果你只有 5 至 10 分鐘準備化妝，呢款眼影都好好用。我希望佢哋推出更多色號。

reviews.text: The N°1 Pit-a-pat shade is so pretty. The glitter is chunky and opalescent, perfect for layering over colored eye shadow. When you are in the sun, the light reflects off of the larger chunks of glitter really nicely. The glitter has finer and larger pieces and can be worn alone on the eyes, or with the shadow shade in the palette. The shadow is the perfect neutral color to put on your eyes or use as blush. Like the name “Tap Me”, tapping your finger with the glitter once picks up a good amount and the glitter will stay on your eyes all day.
reviews.zh: N°1 Pit-a-pat 色號真係好靚。閃粉粗大、有蛋白石光澤，好啱疊喺有色眼影上面。喺太陽底下，光線會好靚咁反射喺粗閃粉上面。閃粉有細有粗，可以單獨喺眼上用，或者配埋盤入面嘅眼影色一齊用。呢個中性色好啱做眼影，或者當腮紅都得。就好似個名「Tap Me」咁，用手指輕點閃粉一下，就可以拿到好多，閃粉亦都會整日留喺眼上。

reviews.text:
I bought 2 of these palette. No.1 and No.2
The shadows are creamy, soft and easy to blend out. They can also be used for both heavy smoky look and a natural day look for both going to work or school. The glitters are also impressive, I didn't need to use any extra glue to keep them on my eyelids and face, and surprisingly they didn't move at all, they stayed where I placed them, however it takes a bit of work removing them, for me an oil makeup cleanser did the job quickly, but be careful, just apply the oil cleanser on a cotton pad and lightly press it onto the areas where the glitters need to be removed, then swipe away lightly, avoid swiping in the direction where the glitters are likely to get into your eyes. Will be repurchasing again to gift. XD
reviews.zh:
我買咗呢盤嘅兩款，No.1 同 No.2。
眼影質地綿密、柔軟，容易推開。可以化濃煙燻妝，亦可以化自然日妝，上班或者返學都啱。閃粉都好出色，我唔需要額外用膠水都可以貼喺眼皮同面上，而且令人驚訝嘅係，佢哋放咗喺邊就留喺邊，一動都唔郁。不過，要除走佢就要花啲功夫。我用卸妝油好快就搞掂，但係要小心：將卸妝油倒喺棉花片上，輕輕壓喺需要除去閃粉嘅位置，然後輕輕抹走，避免向閃粉可能跌入眼睛嘅方向抹。會再買嚟送畀人。XD

reviews.text: This is the perfect everyday eyeshadow colour! You can add a bit of sparkle and it really enhances your makeup look. The pigmentation of the eyeshadow is so pretty and the colour pay off is really good. I would totally recommend this product. I was so happy to receive this product in perfect condition and it didn't take long to arrive. I can't wait to continue wearing this eyeshadow and plan to keep it in my handbag to recommend to my friends!
reviews.zh: 呢個真係完美嘅日常眼影色！可以加少少閃亮感，真係令妝容更出色。眼影嘅上色效果好靚，色彩發揮效果都好好。我絕對推薦呢款產品。收到嘅產品狀態完美，寄送都好快，我好開心。我好期待繼續用呢款眼影，我打算放喺手袋入面，推薦畀我嘅朋友！

reviews.text: I own both the Get Jewel Palettes by Unleashia (I really liked them), so I figured why not grab these new palettes too! I got all 3, what surprised me was that they weren't overly small like I was expecting, kind of double the size to what I thought I'd get, so that's pretty good! As with previous Unleashia palettes, these have nice smooth matte shadows and soft chunky glitters! It's very simple, but because it's Unleashia it's good stuff (if you're familiar with their glitters you know what I mean). Each shadow palette comes with a matte shadow (pink, brown, beige) and a suitable matching glitter (with glittery chunks), the matte shadows can be soft and buildable while the glitter needs a more gentle application, but otherwise it's all very nice and simple. Overall, 4.5/5. They only some-what negative thing I can say is that these palettes are a bit similar to the Get Jewel Palettes, so if you don't have them try these instead (or buy them all like I did, lol).
reviews.zh: 我已經有兩盤 Unleashia 嘅 Get Jewel 眼影盤（我好鍾意），所以諗住一齊買呢款新盤！我買咗 3 盤，令我驚喜嘅係佢哋唔會好細，比我預期大咗差唔多一倍，咁就幾好！就好似之前嘅 Unleashia 眼影盤一樣，有幼滑嘅霧面眼影，同埋柔軟嘅粗閃粉！好簡單，但係因為係 Unleashia，所以都係好嘢（如果你熟悉佢哋嘅閃粉，你就會明白我嘅意思）。每個眼影盤都有一款霧面眼影（粉色、啡色、米色）同一款配套嘅閃粉（有粗粒），霧面眼影可以軟身同易疊色，閃粉就要輕力啲上，但係整體都好靚、好簡單。整體嚟講，我俾 4.5/5。唯一有啲負面嘅地方，就係呢啲眼影盤同 Get Jewel 眼影盤有啲相似，所以如果你未有 Get Jewel，可以試吓呢啲（或者好似我咁全部都買，lol）。
